reviewed_inputs.recheck_note: Parent added authority/consumer/effective-action fields during this review. Reopened current body; three scenarios and evaluation conclusions remain unchanged. Initial read hash retained.

reviewed_inputs.read_scope: Quick compatibility review of three protocols, limits, counts, task cards and experience contrasts.

evidence_scope: Independent same-model design review of local proposals; no new product capability claims, experiment results or statistical power claims.

estimands.task_success: Current required deliverable accepted under frozen requirements, independent checks and blinded semantic review.
estimands.human_burden: Active operator, first acceptance review, investigation and correction minutes; report components and total. Research adjudication and maintenance separately.
estimands.continuity: Preserved necessary constraints and valid work after handoff/revision; omissions, erroneous reuse, unnecessary repetitions and time to next useful result.
estimands.recovery: Under a specified fault/evidence model, time to safe status, actionable status and task completion; product unknown separate from each endpoint.
estimands.context_cost: All build/update/retrieval/selector/reader costs, including inner retries, cache and failures; separate task cost, research evaluation cost, maintenance and total.

cost_denominators.primary: Total costs of all assigned/attempted work, including failed, timed-out, invalid and incomplete runs; report assigned and attempted counts separately.
cost_denominators.per_accepted_delivery: All group costs divided by accepted deliveries; undefined when accepted count is zero, with total cost still reported.
cost_denominators.conditional_success_cost: Mean cost restricted to successful runs is a separate selected-subset diagnostic, never a replacement for full cost.
cost_denominators.historical_thresholds: Do not inherit proposed sample sizes, gain thresholds or attribution-agreement targets from historical drafts as validated criteria; confirmation thresholds remain unfrozen.

obligation_credit_rule: A repeat query/check may be useful for a current or future decision or an explicit verification/audit/monitoring obligation. Confirmation of no change is not automatically waste; unnecessary repetition requires absence of these justifications.

excluded_from_counts: both fixed-prefix and on-policy task modes
old_proposal_cost.cost_formula: sum(all role input/output/cache/failed/retry usage at frozen rates)+tool resource cost; human and maintenance minutes reported alongside, with explicitly chosen conversion only if later needed
old_proposal_cost.reason: No measured usage distribution or frozen provider pricing; do not invent amounts.

pilot.purpose: Measurement feasibility, cost distribution, fixture/oracle failures and directional counterexamples; not confirmation.
pilot.split: All six families are development/pilot material; none reused as confirmation after inspection or tuning.
fixed_items: one exact model/provider snapshot and parameters
same source corpus prefix and release schedule
pilot.randomized_unit: Arm execution order within scenario-family block; seed and assignment list frozen before execution.
pilot.paired_unit: Independent family and its full staged episode, not each time point, tool call, retry, or reviewer.
pilot.human_assignment: Reviewer-block balanced across families/arms; a first-reviewer does not see both arm outputs of the same family. Hide labels, costs and self-ratings; UI may reveal condition, so not claimed double-blind.
pilot.model_randomness: Fixed sampling setup and recorded seeds where supported do not make service behavior deterministic; one pilot repeat does not estimate full stochastic variance.

tentative_run_caps.shared_budget_rule: Offline construction and independent grading have separate frozen caps and costs, all within the overall authorized budget.
tentative_run_caps.overflow_rule: Mandatory instructions/tools/policy that exceed the input cap make the condition explicitly infeasible; never silently remove mandatory constraints.

stop_rules: Stop at 12 scheduled task runs; no optional sampling until a desired result appears.
Per episode stop at its final-stage accepted endpoint after all required staged interventions/handoffs, or frozen cap/mandatory-constraint violation; retain every incomplete/failure record.
On broken observation chain, fixture contamination or unobserved effect paths, stop affected configuration and investigate; do not label that evidence as an effect success.
Do not erase method-induced parse failures, budget excesses or missing traces.
Only predefined arm-independent shared infrastructure failure may trigger one complete paired-block rerun within budget; retain original pair and all costs.

analysis.report: Per-family paired outcome vectors, descriptive deltas, completion status, oracle coverage and full cost accounting.
no_inferential_claims: no p-value or bootstrap-based universal gain from two families per scenario
analysis.denominator: All preregistered attempted episodes remain in the outcome ledger. Missing evidence is not acceptance; an inability to observe effects is not fabricated evidence of wrong effects.
analysis.intervals: No inferential confidence intervals for this pilot; confirmation interval method to be specified after design choices are frozen.
analysis.quality_gate: Required requirements cannot be offset by lower tokens. Operational tradeoffs and minimum meaningful benefit must be separately frozen before confirmation.

scenarios.name: Coding revision to reviewable delivery
scenarios.claim_under_test: Version-bound state/evidence and handoff bundle improve valid continuity or lower human burden without degrading current functional delivery.
scenarios.baseline: Competent Git-based workflow with task checklist, raw tool/test logs, current requirements and identical enforcement.
scenarios.candidate: Same inputs/tools/model plus version-bound Record/evidence view and explicit handoff bundle.
scenarios.treatment_scope: Bundle-level effect only; cannot attribute separately to DAG, schema or UI.

families.condition: Relevant requirement revision between attempts; old evidence remains historical.
Irrelevant note after valid evidence; no unrelated time/policy changes.

scenarios.unit: One feature family and staged revision trajectory on cloned independent workspaces.
observables: time after handoff to useful artifact
scenarios.independent_oracle: Frozen requirement-level tests and review rubric produced independently of the candidate checker; negative controls included.
scenarios.stop: Normal completion iff required_stages_completed AND final_stage_accepted; mandatory-constraint violation or frozen cap are early incomplete/failure exits. Earlier acceptance is an intermediate observation, never the episode endpoint.
confounds: treating necessary new-spec verification as waste
extra raw information in candidate metadata
UI transparency versus underlying reasoning improvement
scenarios.attribution: Information missing / selection omission / reasoning-action error / state-binding error / checker mismatch / environment failure may coexist; preserve evidence and uncertainty.
scenarios.allowed_conclusion: Local effect of the tested state/evidence/handoff bundle on these feature families with this model and review procedure.

freeze_before_run: family-specific required stage list and intervention trigger
handoff identity and visible material at each stage
meaning of final_stage_accepted under final applicable specification
run horizon and rule for a stage never reached

stages.endpoint: intermediate observation only, even if initially accepted

stages.purpose: apply frozen A1 relevant revision or A2 unrelated note at its logical trigger
stages.endpoint: intervention receipt plus handoff to the designated continuation actor/session

stages.purpose: continue under final applicable specification, inspect impact, preserve or update evidence, final review
stages.endpoint: final acceptance after required stages are witnessed

stage_protocol.unreached_stage: Keep episode in assigned/attempted denominator; report last stage and missing intervention separately. Failure before trigger is not silently excluded.
stage_protocol.a2_rule: An unrelated note does not by itself invalidate evidence; final review may reuse still-applicable evidence without rerunning unchanged checks.
stage_protocol.no_extra_runs: Stages are within each existing paired episode; target run count remains 12.

scenarios.name: Long-running work under disconnect and recovery
scenarios.claim_under_test: Explicit action/effect state and reconciliation reduce incorrect repetition or human investigation while preserving progress when authoritative recovery evidence becomes available.
scenarios.baseline: Durable checkpoints, ordinary logs and authoritative target-query runbook; no intentionally naive blind replay.
scenarios.candidate: Same target idempotency/fencing/query abilities plus action/effect separation, unknown liabilities and structured reconciliation.

families.condition: Target committed; response lost; authoritative committed evidence later available.
Authoritative termination and not-applied proof available after fault; remaining work can safely continue.

scenarios.unit: Task family plus target world and logical fault barrier; each arm has cloned target state and same evidence-release schedule.
scenarios.fault_injection: Use verified target/egress logical barriers, not elapsed wall-clock seconds. Arm failing before barrier stays in pre-fault outcome ledger.
scenarios.independent_oracle: Target audit plus controlled egress and fault receipts; adapter's own success message is not the effect oracle.
scenarios.stop: Remaining work completed or frozen observation/run horizon; a correctly unresolved outcome remains incomplete rather than a claimed bounded-liveness violation.

diagnostic_extension.oracle: Correct preservation of product unknown and actionable next step; conformance may succeed.
diagnostic_extension.excluded_claim: Cannot count as task completion or automatic recovery-speed benefit.

confounds: excluding arms that fail before injection
conflating conformance SUCCESS with task completion
scenarios.allowed_conclusion: Specified finite fault traces under the declared capabilities and observation coverage; task progress and contract preservation reported separately.
prohibited_conclusions: no duplicate effect outside observed scope or retention window

scenarios.name: Research evidence changes to an actionable decision
scenarios.claim_under_test: B5 rule timeline plus raw retrieval gives net task benefit over B3 raw retrieval for temporal correction, uncertainty handling and usable next action.
scenarios.baseline: B3 fixed lexical retrieval over the raw corpus.
scenarios.candidate: B5 same retrieval/corpus plus deterministic timeline derived only from observable event fields.

families.condition: Latest correction supersedes an earlier premise before final decision.
Late-arriving information with unresolved conflict; as-known-then differs from current view.

scenarios.unit: Topic family with a full three-cutoff source-release trajectory, not each cutoff as an independent observation.
observables: correct next action under current constraints
index build and incremental update resources
scenarios.independent_oracle: Frozen requirement/evidence rubric permits alternative sufficient evidence sets; hidden answer and future source updates excluded from all inputs.
scenarios.visibility: available_at <= cutoff for raw data, metadata, summaries and indices.
scenarios.stop: Final fixed cutoff deliverable accepted or frozen budget/horizon; do not stop early when an arm appears better.
scenarios.allowed_conclusion: Tested B5/B3 comparison for this temporal research-task sample and budget.

failure_attribution.method: Use frozen event/input/manifest/output trace and independent oracle; record multiple hypotheses and adjudication. A later diagnostic replay is separate from the primary paired result.
failure_attribution.prevents: Do not relabel all candidate failures as infrastructure or force every failure into one causal label.

transfer_extension.purpose: Frozen experience reuse, not online lifelong-learning proof.
transfer_extension.budget_note: At least two development task runs plus separate library generation/indexing calls in addition to 18 target runs; no hidden free build.
isolation: split by source/task family not paraphrase
freeze rule library and trace library
same current target materials across arms
no target results or judge feedback in library
no within-round prompt/rule/model selection using target outcomes
rebuild new version only for later development, never overwrite evaluation inputs

contrasts.raw_vs_none: Overall value of additional prior experience under the fixed budget.
contrasts.summary_vs_raw: Value/cost of experience representation from the same development facts.

transfer_extension.allowed_conclusion: Transfer from a particular frozen library to the preregistered unseen sample.

online_growth_separate.feedback: each arm's own prior trajectories and same declared operational feedback; hidden evaluation labels withheld until block end
online_growth_separate.outcome: sequence-level learning curves and cumulative cost with matched difficulty/order
online_growth_separate.not_assumed: Tasks are independent samples or later tasks are naturally easier.

complexity_ablation.principle: Candidate complexity earns inclusion only through a scoped contrast; delete components that no longer improve the outcome vector.
complexity_ablation.later_comparison: One component removed at a time with same task/requirements/model; if dependencies prevent isolation, label the compared bundle.
complexity_ablation.model_upgrade: Re-freeze exact models and repeat scoped ablations; old model results do not rank newer models or harnesses.

confirmation_prerequisites: independent fixtures and oracle cover required behavior
measurement pilot reveals no unresolved data contamination
precise primary contrast and task population
minimum meaningful task benefit and human-burden/quality margins chosen before confirmation
cluster/family-aware sample design and interval method
frozen total budget and actual execution authorization
not_supported_by_this_plan: statistical power from the pilot size
universal benefit from a more complex harness
validation_scope: JSON/document structural checks only; no fixture execution or benefit evidence.

relationship_to_mechanisms.default_start: W-05 12-target-run calibration pilot only; not an effect-size confirmation
relationship_to_mechanisms.conformance: Selected relevant contract checks may serve as fixture preflight; do not add all C01-C16 as default model task runs.
relationship_to_mechanisms.W01: Optional later decision/replanning bundle study: 12 task cards x 2 conditions x 2 repeats = 48 episodes; task cards are not 12 completed runs.
relationship_to_mechanisms.W02: Optional larger experience-package study: 72 heldout episodes plus separate training/development/library costs.
relationship_to_mechanisms.W03: Optional candidate-search ablation after an already acceptable baseline; not a prerequisite of W-05.
relationship_to_mechanisms.alternate_small_transfer: W-05 optional 18 target runs plus at least 2 development trajectory runs and separate library calls can calibrate the transfer question before any larger W02 study.
relationship_to_mechanisms.caps: Profiles differ: mechanisms has 8 model calls/64000 total input, W-05 proposes 40 online model calls/8000 input per call. Freeze one explicit profile for any borrowed card; never combine permissive maxima or compare as if equal budgets.
relationship_to_mechanisms.estimand_difference: W02 success-only raw traces versus lessons including counterexamples is a package contrast. W-05 raw versus summarized transfer conditions use the same complete development facts to isolate representation more closely.
relationship_to_mechanisms.future_decision: Select one optional follow-up based on calibration and intended claim; do not concatenate all experiments into a mandatory campaign.

revision_note: Root integration correction for R06 WP01; no execution or budget change.
